column1: # Tier 1: GitHub issues and PRs in the linux-surface org that mention the Surface Pro 9 (title, body or comments).
# Harvest: GitHub search API (org:linux-surface "surface pro 9" | "pro 9" | sp9 | pro9 | MSHW0343), 2026-11-12, via browser.
# id: "#N" = linux-surface/linux-surface, otherwise <repo>#N in the linux-surface org.
# kind: I issue, PR pull request, +m merged. state: O open, C closed, NP closed not planned.
# tags: which searches matched (sp9, sp8, ithc, ipu6, ov5693, ov13858, vd55g0, int3472, pen, buttons, irqstorm, psr, thc,
#   securecore, fedora, libwacom, initramfs, kbbacklight, battery, audio, tabletmode, iptsd, s0ix, tb, sleep, acpi, adl, sl5).
#   "sp9" from the broad "pro 9" search is noisy: long threads that mention a Pro 9 once also match. ARM = SQ3/5G/Pro X.
# kernels: kernel versions seen in the thread. refs: cross references and links (#N, repo#N, repo@sha, external).
# last: author and start of the last comment that was visible in the page payload.
